title: An agent's hand-back refuses when its report names a commit that does not exist
why: Four Haiku test-author runs in lane comment-check-scans-shell made no edit and reported commit hashes that do not exist (8c1f0e2a7, 5b7d10a42, e7c35b1d0, 3d2a91f4c; git cat-file fails on each; no guard refused). The orchestrator nearly took a false 'done' (coordinator, 01:29 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: at an agent's stop, check each commit hash in its report with `git cat-file -e`; a missing hash refuses the hand-back and names it. Red case first: a report with one made-up hash; control: a report whose hashes all exist. Owner item 406 asks for a Sonnet test-author for the same lane. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 01:31 CST Nov 8.
